name: Make Forward Solution
summary: Computes an MEG/EEG forward solution (lead field) with MNE-Python make_forward_solution from the subject's source space, coregistration transform and BEM, or from the fsaverage template when none are given.
description: Combines channel information from raw, epoched or evoked data with a source space, a head-to-MRI transform and a BEM solution to compute the lead-field matrix (fwd.fif), plus a sensor-head alignment figure and an HTML report. Supply source space, trans and BEM all together for a native-anatomy forward model, or none of them to use the fsaverage oct6 template (no coregistration, so source locations can be off by several centimetres). Mixed combinations that pair a template with native anatomy are refused. Use it before computing an inverse solution.

inputs.description: Epoched data, used for channel information and projectors.
inputs.requirements: At least one of raw, epochs or evoked is required; the most processed one is used (evoked > epochs > raw).

inputs.description: Evoked (averaged) data, used for channel information and projectors.
Continuous data, used for channel information and projectors.
Pre-computed source space (src.fif), e.g. from app-source-space-v2.
inputs.requirements: Give together with trans and bem, or leave all three empty (an fsaverage source space alone is also accepted).

inputs.description: Head-to-MRI coregistration transform, e.g. from app-coreg-v2.
inputs.requirements: Must be given together with the BEM.
Must be given together with trans and describe the same subject as the source space.

parameters.description: Minimum distance of sources from inner skull surface (in mm).

citations.text: Gramfort A. et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Frontiers in Neuroscience 7:267 (2013).
